fix(test): the click-error e2e holds its unanswered render until the daemon's side has ended (brandon-unfiled-3248.cbyb) (#570)

* fix(test): the click-error e2e holds its unanswered render until the daemon's side has ended (brandon-unfiled-3248.cbyb)

The case's `gone` client half-closed at once and assumed the daemon saw the
close before it wrote the answer. Nothing ordered them: when the render won, the
end-write succeeded, the error was marked answered, and the next request read
`over` where the test expects `owed`.

The gone render now reads tmux through the gated stub, and the test opens the
gate only once the daemon's side has closed with the client's (inFlight back to
0), so the answer meets an ended end by construction. Making respond call
delivered regardless of the write error fails the case with owed/over.

* test: say why zero in flight means the gone client's side left (brandon-unfiled-3248.cbyb)

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.179.2 [skip ci]

## [1.179.2](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.179.1...v1.179.2) (2026-11-02)

### Bug Fixes

* **frame-feed:** a timer that fires before its moment waits it out, so no turn is drawn twice ([#566](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/566)) ([e9865fa](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/e9865fa4807325c4bf8e73c86195d8ea246a2775))
* **url-handle:** a daemon's TIMEOUT is busy, so a click no longer kicks a live daemon ([#565](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/565)) ([938e467](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/938e46704e2e803c9a983b478618dda5cea40cc3))
fix(e2e): the sign-off guard splits on & and substitutions, follows cd, and probes each path once (candybar-testing-ihvy.7dc)
fix(e2e): the sign-off guard sees directories, quoted paths and worktrees; shrink check fails on git errors (candybar-testing-ihvy.7dc)

test(e2e): the cap and the assertion limit are enforced (candybar-testing-ihvy.7dc)

The sign-off file (.claude/e2e-signoff.json) holds the end-to-end cap and the
assertion limit. jest.e2e.config.js adds a reporter that fails a run holding
more tests than the cap and a setup file that fails a test whose assertion
count is not the limit; every other config ignores test/e2e/, so no run
reaches an end-to-end test without them. Fixtures that break each check, run
through the real config by test/integration/e2e-checks, turn red if a check is
unplugged. The e2e-signoff hook now refuses an agent's edit to the sign-off,
the checks, their tests and fixtures, itself, and any test/e2e/ file that
origin/main holds, and fails closed.

A workflow check fails CI on a step that reaches a script importing
daemonArgs or createDaemon. load-gate.yml is excused on a transitional list
(test/transitional-daemon-workflows) that a CI step holds to shrinking;
candybar-testing-ihvy.4vv deletes the directory.

fix(daemon): handoff verdicts are exhaustive, bound is monotonic, rate-limit logs the category (candybar-launch-q7o7.hx4)

Review (medium) of #568: clickFailed's reason is the launch-failure union;
a timeout verdict fails the click rather than reading as lost; the bound uses
performance.now(); the rate-limit warning names the category, not the URL; a
handoff left running at the bound is logged; the test's wait is bounded and
cleans its dir.

fix(daemon): a handoff click maps refusals like any click, and a lost opener fails loudly (candybar-launch-q7o7.hx4)

Review (high) of #568: the job's refusal carries its reason, so a rate-limited
opener is logged and acknowledged and a closing daemon is DaemonClosing. One
failure mapping serves both click launches. A job whose group ends with no
verdict is lost and throws. Stdout goes to /dev/null so a handed-off browser
fills no unlinked file; the dir removal retries the verdict-write race; the
bound is a parameter so tests run in ms.
fix(daemon): an opener's click hands off, so the browser outlives the 5s bound (candybar-launch-q7o7.hx4)

feat(templates): array-form segment templates and segment-scoped partials (candybar-templates-zh8b.53s)

A segment's `template` may now be an array of strings (joined with no
separator) for a long conditional that would otherwise be one unreadable
line, and a segment may declare `partials`: named sub-templates scoped to
it, compiled onto their own Defines chained from the shared `helpers`, so
two segments can reuse a partial name with no collision and a partial can
call a helper but never another segment's partial. Dispatch is via the
existing static `{{ template "name" ctx }}` builtin.

The dynamic `partial` function (a computed name) needs a capability
(`include`) that exists only on @promptctl/go-template-js's unreleased
master, not its published npm version — split into a follow-up ticket
(candybar-templates-zh8b.ph5), blocked on that release. Static unused-
partial detection needs unused.ts to carry per-template segment identity,
which it does not today — split into its own follow-up
(candybar-templates-zh8b.mfn), not blocked on anything upstream.

docs(design): the isolated daemon, tmux events and browser surface designs

Goals, architecture, contracts and one document per area, with the surveys and probes behind them. The Frame is recorded as built, and the browser surface is un-parked.
fix(bar-pane): a frame overwrites its rows and lands whole, so the pane stops flickering
